scope.flow: GTELaunchpadV2Pair launchpad fee accrual and swap amountIn accounting
scope.environment: GTE AMM liquidity pair contract (Uniswap V2-like) with additional launchpad fee

statements.text: Two or more state-changing calls (e.g., swap, mint+swap, or burn+swap) occur within the same block, so timeElapsed == 0.
A launchpad fee is accrued but not distributed because timeElapsed == 0, and is virtually subtracted from reserves.
The very next call to the contract is a swap function call.

The swap function counts the undistributed accrued fee as amountIn (amount0In or amount1In) because of how amountIns are calculated, and the inflated amountIn generates new launchpad fees, creating a fee-on-fee feedback loop.
The swap amountIn calculation must exclude accrued undistributed launchpad fees so that only true deposits are counted as amountIn.
New launchpad fees must be computed only on true deposits, then added to accrued for distribution.
The launchpad fee should normally be distributed directly to the launchpad whenever _update is called.

ambiguities: No explicit actor or authorization condition is stated for triggering the same-block calls or the swap; permissionlessness is not asserted.
The report does not state whether the same-block calls and the subsequent swap are performed by the same or different actors.
The report does not give a concrete numeric bound for the undistributed fee or the inflated amountIn; only PoC example values are mentioned.
The report does not specify whether the swap that counts the accrued fee is the immediate next transaction or merely the next call to the contract.
